name: eternal-expeditions
description: A full-stack tour booking platform - Learn Node.js, Express, MongoDB with React & Vite
author: Abhishek Kushwaha

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=client" "npm run cross-env NODE_ENV=development nodemon server.js --workspace=server"
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run build:preview --workspace=client" "npm run cross-env NODE_ENV=production node server.js --workspace=server"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=client && npm run lint --workspace=server
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --workspace=client && npm run lint:fix --workspace=server
scripts.format: npm run format --workspace=client && npm run format --workspace=server
